questions.stem: A gas has no fixed shape and no fixed volume because its particles:

options.text: Are far apart with negligible forces between them and move randomly at high speeds
Are held together by strong forces of attraction
Are closely packed and slide past each other

questions.explanation: Gas particles are far apart with negligible forces of attraction between them. They move randomly at high speeds in all directions, which means a gas has no fixed shape and will expand to fill any container.
